claim.summary: For any fixed binary affine tuple on both matrix sides, conditional on a common inner basis and paired live set, PHP row reduction gives c+Z xi+H x with uniform dead-label bits xi. Its affine consistency probability is zero if pi(c) is outside im(pi Z), and otherwise 2^-kappa, kappa=rank[H Z]-rank H. Inconsistency supplies a legal constant ENS row with every companion certified through degree two. A joint inventory with summed consistency probabilities below one admits common-label simultaneous removal without inter-block independence. For fixed distinct-row column inputs, the row-reduced tuple has full live rank with probability 1-(2^(n-n'+1)-1)/(2^n-1) over a uniform inner basis with an independently fixed live set, hence this normalizer fails there regardless of labels.
claim.assessment: Elementary exact affine baseline and scoped source normalization, preserving the degree-two CNF gate boundary. Consistency is modulo linear PHP row equations, not every functional PHP consequence; raw consistency does not imply actual source hardness. No nonlinear gate/product source coverage or new old-affine lower bound is claimed.
